posts.title_en: Bitaxe Was Half the Equation. Life Is the Other Half.
posts.title_fr: Bitaxe était la moitié de l'équation. Le Vivant est l'autre moitié.
posts.hook_en: Every watt entering a CMOS gate exits as 100% Joule heat. When you snap a closed-loop biosphere dome onto a 17W Bitaxe Gamma 601, SHA-256 stops being 'waste heat' and becomes a self-watering micro-climate.
posts.hook_fr: Chaque watt entrant dans une porte CMOS ressort à 100 % sous forme de chaleur Joule. En couplant un dôme biosphérique fermé sur un Bitaxe Gamma 601 de 17 W, SHA-256 devient un micro-climat auto-irrigué.
posts.x_post:
Bitaxe was half the equation: open-source silicon hashing on your desk.

The other half? Capturing 100% of its Joule heat to drive a closed-loop condensation dome, Terra Preta biochar & living moss.

From a 17W desk topper to feeding Madagascar & terraforming Mars.

114-year low time preference. #RegenerativeCompute
posts.linkedin_post:
Bitaxe solved open-source sovereign hashing. Now we complete the equation: coupling 100% Joule heat recovery with closed-loop biospheres.

At Regenerative Compute (Lemuria Technologies), we measure civilizational progress by a new KPI: lifting societies starting from the most vulnerable—bringing food and water security to all Madagascans and Lemurians over a 114-year horizon (2026–2140), while flight-qualifying the closed-loop life support needed for Mars.

Countdown to Block #1,000,000 is live at regenerativecompute.io.
posts.video_warmth_prompt: Macro 4K 60fps warm golden-hour cinematography: an open-source Bitaxe miner sitting in a charred-timber cradle on an oak desk in Sydney, gentle amber convection shimmer rising into an anodized aluminum dish holding dark Terra Preta biochar and lush green fern moss inside a borosilicate glass cloche dome, sparkling condensation droplets falling onto leaves, shallow depth of field, warm tungsten rim light, serene organic-tech warmth.
